about: What real use, and the person Pit Board is for, showed must change or must stay true in Windstorm Pit Board, and the version each is due in. A lesson here is a gate, not a note: tests/test_g21_promises.py (G21.14) refuses a version while a row due in it is not built, and refuses the version after it until the row says where it was proven on a real machine.
how_to_use: A new lesson gets a row the day it is learned: what was seen, the promise, a codon in DNA-STRAND-MASTER-PLAN.md, the version it is due in, and a tracking issue when work is left.
When it is built: put the name of its test in 'test'. The test must exist under tests/ and be named with the row's codon (test_G10_5_... for G10.5).
When it has been seen to work on a real machine: say which machine, which version and when in 'proven'.

'ship_in' moves only with a reason in 'moved_why'. A row whose owner is 'person' was seen by the person Pit Board is for, on their own machine: its date moves only by their word, restated in 'moved_by_person'.
A row is never deleted. A promise that turns out wrong is closed by a row that says why.
A lesson that was heard and not taken goes under 'declined' with the reason, so that nothing is dropped without a word.
